tools.name: run_command

input.command:
cat > fizzpops-great-escape.txt << 'EOF'
Fizzpop's Great Escape

Deep in the frosty kingdom of the refrigerator, there lived a brave little can of soda named Fizzpop. With his shiny silver armor and a belly full of fizzy secrets, Fizzpop dreamed of the world beyond the condiment condos.

One fateful summer day, a giant hand—belonging to a boy named Timmy—plucked Fizzpop from his shelf. "Yes! Adventure awaits!" Fizzpop bubbled excitedly.

Timmy dashed outside to the backyard barbecue. He shook Fizzpop like a maraca, building up the fizz. "Hold on tight!" Timmy grinned, cracking open the tab.

KA-BLAM! Fizzpop erupted in a spectacular geyser of cherry cola, showering Timmy, the burgers, and even the family dog. Laughter echoed as everyone cheered the fizzy fountain.

As his last bubbles danced in the sun, Fizzpop whispered, "What a poppin' life!"
EOF
&& wc -w fizzpops-great-escape.txt

Bubblina's Wild Ride

In the chilly confines of the office fridge, Bubblina the lemon-lime soda dreamed of action beyond the yogurt guards. Her silver sides tingled with untapped fizz.

One hectic lunch hour, Alex the skateboarder yanked her from the shelf. "Fuel for flips!" he declared, stuffing Bubblina into his battered backpack.

The skate park awaited: ramps, rails, and radical tricks. Every ollie and grind rattled Bubblina's bubbles into a frenzy.

Mid-air on a massive half-pipe, Alex cracked her open. "Go time!"

KABOOM! A zesty geyser erupted, drenching the ramp and turning it into a slippery spectacle. Skaters whooped, sliding into victory laps amid citrus showers.

Bubblina's final fizz whispered, "Totally tubular!"
EOF
